title: Meetings that end with decisions
concept: One long trainer's whiteboard. Sam's meeting is drawn and redrawn as the three moves are applied: a checklist (Before, During, Close) in the top-right corner of every board fills with ticks as each move lands, and the payoff returns to the same table where the hook began.

cast.name: Sam
cast.role: runs the weekly project meeting; the running character

cast.name: Lena
cast.role: teammate; picks up the parked item

devices.what: the three-step checklist Before / During / Close in the top-right corner of every board, a rough tick box per step, the current step in ink and the others muted, each box ticked by hand as its move lands (kit part step_list)
Sam's meeting invite drawn as a rough card: its topic line struck through and rewritten as a question, its guest row trimmed; returns blank as the learner's agenda (kit part invite_card)
the team at the table with speech bubbles: different answers in b02, one shared line after the summary is sent in b12 (kit part team_table)
the written decision in three parts (what, who, by when), each underlined as it is read back; folded into the email and written on the payoff table (kit part decision_line)
one long board: a calm camera pan to the next part of the board within a section, a field2 wipe at a section turn

value_script.why: an open board: ink only, the accent only on the question marks
the board fills as each move is drawn; one marker colour per board on the stressed thing; ticks in ink
the turn: the bubbles become one; in b13 the last tick lands in green (pos), the only green of the film
a clean board for the learner's own agenda

parts.what: The trainer's three-step checklist, about 380 x 300 px, for the top-right corner of a board (x 1420 to 1800, y 96 to 400). Three rows: a rough tick box (about 56 px) then the word Before / During / Close in Patrick Hand lead. Opts: current (0,1,2 or -1: that row's word in ink, the others muted), ticked (array of three booleans: drawn already ticked). Methods: draw(t) draws boxes then writes words in order; appear() shows it complete at once (for a board the camera pans onto); tick(i, t, {tone}) draws a hand tick in the box (ink by default, 'pos' only in b13); setCurrent(i, t) moves the ink from one word to the next (muted to ink fade).

Sam's meeting invite as a rough hand-drawn card, about 900 x 600 px: a small calendar icon and the header word 'Invite' (or 'Agenda' in blank mode), a title line, and below it a guest row of six Lucide user pictograms at marker weight. Methods: draw(t); setTitle(text, t) writes the title line; strike(t) draws an ink strike-through across the title; rewrite(text, t) writes the replacement in Caveat title size just under the struck line; guests(t) draws the six pictograms one after another; markGuest(i, label, t) writes a label under one pictogram; crossGuest(i, t) draws an ink cross over one; envelope(t) draws a Lucide mail icon to the right of the card with a hand arrow from the crossed guests to it; blank mode draws empty ruled lines with a '?' slot on the first line. No accent inside the part: scenes add their one accent mark.

The meeting table seen from the front: one long hand line for the table top and four chair backs, with the cast seated behind it as Open Peeps busts by cast look (Sam, Priya, Dev, Lena, left to right, about 300 px each, bust bottoms ON the table line, kit.peep with the cast's member, skin and cloth). Methods: draw(t) draws table and chairs; arrive(t) fades the four people in (stagger); leave(t) fades them out leaving empty chairs; nameTag(i, text, t) writes a name under a person; bubble(i, content, t) draws a rough speech bubble above one person with short text (or a scribble when content is null); clearBubbles(t); emotion per person on call (neutral, happy, explaining). People are never drawn from shapes.

One written decision in three parts on one line: 'Pilot ships in June' | 'Priya' | 'by Friday', Patrick Hand lead, ink, about 1100 px wide (a compact size about 700 px for the email and the table). Methods: write(t) writes the parts left to right; underline(i, t) draws a hand underline under part i; label(i, text, t) writes a muted label under part i (What, Who, By when); fold(t) shrinks it (for the email).
